commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: - Re-verified the still-live Vite pipeline (`npm run build:check`) still builds successfully after the `main.ts` edit.
- `npx astro check` (0 errors, same 1 pre-existing unrelated hint), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests) all still pass.

- Next: Phase 4 (doc pages) — `DocsLayout.astro`, `Sidebar.astro`, `src/pages/algorithms/[id]/index.astro` + `getStaticPaths`, Shiki syntax highlighting (verify `rs`→`rust` lang-id mapping), CSS-only first-table styling (replacing the custom marked table renderer), confirm/fix the `dist/_astro/` vs `dist/assets/` asset-directory-name question flagged back in Phase 0 for `copy-wasm.mjs`/`public/_headers`.
- **Phase 4 (doc pages) — done.** All 18 algorithm doc pages generated from one dynamic route.

- Built `src/components/Sidebar.astro` (server-rendered from `nav-data.ts`, no client JS at all — `currentId` now comes directly from `getStaticPaths()` params instead of `window.location.pathname` regex-matching, so `algorithms-sidebar.ts`'s whole client-inference approach is now provably unnecessary), `src/layouts/DocsLayout.astro` (wraps `BaseLayout` with the two-column `docs-layout`/`docs-sidebar`/`docs-main` grid + breadcrumb), and `src/pages/algorithms/[id]/index.astro` (`getStaticPaths()` over the `docs` collection, `render(entry)` for the Markdown body).
- **`rs`→`rust` Shiki lang-id question was moot**: grepped `docs/algorithms/*.md` for ` ```rs ` fences — zero matches. No rust code fences exist in the docs today, so nothing to verify.

- **Real styling bug found and fixed via screenshot inspection, not caught by any automated check**: Astro/Shiki's default code-block theme is `github-dark`, but the site is light-themed (PicoCSS `data-theme="light"`, and the old pipeline used `@speed-highlight/core`'s `github-light.css`). Without a fix, every code block on every doc page would have rendered with a jarring dark box against the light page. Fixed with `markdown: { shikiConfig: { theme: 'github-light' } }` in `astro.config.mjs`.

- Resolved the `dist/_astro/` vs `dist/assets/` question flagged in Phase 0: added `build: { assets: 'assets' }` to `astro.config.mjs`, pinning Astro's output directory name to match Vite's old default — zero changes needed to `scripts/copy-wasm.mjs` or `public/_headers`' `/assets/*.wasm` Content-Type rule. Confirmed via build output: `.wasm`/worker chunks now land in `dist/assets/` as expected.

- `docs.css`: replaced the class-based `.docs-meta-table` selector (applied by the old pipeline's custom `marked` table renderer, first-table-only) with an additive `.docs-main table:first-of-type` CSS-only selector for the new pipeline — kept the old class selector too since `docs.css` is still shared with the live Vite pipeline; purely additive, no regression risk.

- Verified via Playwright + full-page screenshot on `/algorithms/sa/`: sidebar renders all 18 solvers grouped correctly with the current one highlighted as a non-link span, breadcrumb, type badge, explainer CTA, metadata table (clean first-table styling), pseudocode block (`text` lang tag from earlier PR #272 work — confirmed intentional, not a bug), and syntax-highlighted `bash` Usage blocks all render correctly and visually consistent with the site's light theme. Cross-checked `/algorithms/bhk/` (no explainer → CTA correctly absent) and `/algorithms/stochastic_hill/` (18th solver, renders correctly with its own type badge, no CTA since it has no explainer).
- Sitemap coverage confirmed: all 22 currently-built pages (4 static + 18 docs) present in `dist/sitemap-0.xml`, zero duplicates, zero missing.
- `npx astro check` (0 errors), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests), and `npm run build:check` (still-live Vite pipeline) all pass.

- Next: Phase 5 (home/app page WASM wiring) — this is largely already verified working (Phase 3's Playwright check ran a full solve), so Phase 5 is mostly a confirmation/hardening pass rather than new work: double-check WebMCP forms stay outside any island boundary, verify `webmcp.ts`/`worker.ts` need no further changes. Then Phase 6 (explainer islands) is the next real chunk of new work.

commit.message:
Log Phase 4 (doc pages) completion for Astro migration

All 18 algorithm doc pages generated from one dynamic route via
getStaticPaths over the docs collection. Fixed a real Shiki theme
mismatch (default github-dark vs the site's light theme) found via
screenshot inspection, not any automated check. Resolved the
dist/_astro vs dist/assets question from Phase 0 by pinning
build.assets — zero changes needed to copy-wasm.mjs/_headers.
rs->rust lang mapping question was moot (no rust fences exist).

Implements [[tasks/teeline-web-astro7-migration]]
